mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 7.5% signals labor market tightening that increases corporate profit margins through wage growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 7.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts above 850 thousand units and residential sales above 400,000 million dollars indicate robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 850 and RSAFS > 400000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE above 8.0%) triggers accommodative monetary policy that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 95.0 indicates expanding manufacturing output, reducing recession risk and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 230.0 indicates elevated inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that reduces equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts above 850 thousand units and industrial production above 95.0 indicate synchronized demand and supply expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 850 and INDPRO > 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 95.0 signals manufacturing contraction, increasing recession risk and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
